normalisation.tail_markers: as round 1: T_S and T_LI compared as (inci lower-cased, whitespace collapsed, Parfum/Fragrance aliases folded to parfum; rank; status); T_S.alt ignored (both lanes now emit it, but only for unresolved markers; reported in notes, not compared).
normalisation.reason_code: R2 CHANGE. Lane A now writes reason_code only for provisional_boundary; for every other route A's canonical reason is derived from its rule_path (the first rule_path entry that ends in "→/⇒ styling" names the pair rule: first of 3.4(iii)/3.4(ii)/3.4(i)/3.5 in that entry, 3.1 ignored; route oil -> 3.1, dry_shampoo -> 3.2, heat_protectant -> 3.3, leave_in -> 3.4(iii)_in_category; an entry "§4.6 registry … override" -> 4.6_owner_named). Lane B uses a new vocabulary: direct_styling -> 3.4(ii); non_aqueous_styling -> 3.5; styling_first -> 3.4(iii)_excluded_styling_first; conditioning_first -> 3.4(iii)_in_category, or 4.6_owner_named when B's rule_path starts with §4.6; oil_name_rule -> 3.1; refresh_first -> 3.2; protection_first -> 3.3; ruled_styling / ruled_styling_first -> 4.6_owner_named; dry_hair_finish -> the pair rule its rule_path names (3.4(ii) or 3.5), else "dry_hair_finish(pair_unnamed)". Boundary reasons are identical strings in both lanes.
normalisation.result_mechanisms: as round 1: sorted set of mechanism values; members not compared.
normalisation.application_moment: both lanes now emit {primary, also[]}; primary compared (as round 1); also[] reported as a supplementary field.
normalisation.primary_job: string or null ("review" kept as a value)
normalisation.neutral_fact: whitespace collapsed, quotes unified; null = not shown
normalisation.d8b_flags: sorted set; null (no Styling profile) kept distinct from []
normalisation.informational_values: R2 CHANGE. Lane A emits formula values on 43 non-Styling records (leave_in, oil, heat_protectant, dry_shampoo, mixed_promise, li_g0_provisional) marked informational_and_non_authoritative (standard §4.7 makes them optional and non-authoritative; the sealed file does not score them). Lane B does not emit them. They are masked to null before comparison, so only authoritative values are compared. Supplementary ingredient_flags are masked the same way for any lane record without a Styling profile.
normalisation.secondary_jobs: supplementary, sorted set; null kept distinct from []
normalisation.ingredient_flags: R2 ADDITION (supplementary, both lanes now emit it): object compared with fixative_family sorted.

criterion.rule: PH1-11: >= 6 unseen products, >= 2 traps, matching pre-registered expectations
criterion.verdict: MET. 8 unseen products (>= 6); all 8 boundary traps exercised and caught by both lanes (>= 2). Route + reason match on 8/8 for A and 7/8 for B (slot 8: B named no pair rule; route and every property match). Firm values: A 148/148, B 147/148; soft values 21/21 for both (incl. listed alternatives; exact expected value A 19, B 20). 7 UNDETERMINED values (slots 1, 2, 3, 6, 7) are not scorable; every lane answer lies inside the acceptable set. Both lanes chose mixed_promise on slot 7 where the sealed lean was leave_in (RG2-1).

slots.name: Balea Overnight Wellenspray
slots.trap: Salt-free wave spray vs salt_spray. The name says 'Wellenspray' and the capture candidate is salt_spray, but the promise is a heatless overnight curl/wave set with flexible hold (VP/VA r5), no salt, no beach/texture promise. Secondary: Sodium Bisulfite r7 (an Annex V substance not in PR-1) as a possible marker; Aqua r9 sits between the two marker readings, so 'aqueous' depends on it.
slots.trap_note: salt-free wave spray: neither lane chose salt_spray (A mousse, B gel; subtype itself UNDETERMINED, RG2-13); route styling, not held.

slots.name: Balea Haarwachs Styling Stick
slots.trap: Hairline vs surface target_zone on a wax stick (round-1 slot 2 gap, RG-20): bullets say 'Bändigt abstehende Babyhaare', directions say 'abstehende Härchen fixieren'. Also: §5 rule 2 'gel-type shaping product' on a non-gel; anhydrous wax (3.5); molding vs shine_finish job.
slots.trap_note: hairline vs surface: both lanes target_zone surface („abstehende Härchen"), first real surface case; claims („Babyhaare") did not set U fields.

slots.name: got2b Kleber 4 Brows & Edges 2in1 Stylinggel
slots.trap: Hairline edge gel (§5 rule 2, D1) with brows as a second use (PH1-7, one route); 'Haaransatz' vs the RG-9 'Ansatz => roots' rule; 'Kleber' after RG-14 (rigidity word, not strength); FX-2 unconditional acrylate beside an RH-1 crosspolymer.

disagreements.A_rule_path: 4.1 pass | 4.2 lead C2 „Sorgt für mehr Schwung & [CLAIM] im Haar" (volume/bounce) ⇒ styling_result, li_function no; heat line secondary | aqueous | 3.4(ii) → styling | not held || notes: directions „Ins feuchte Haar sprühen. Haare wie gewohnt föhnen." — blow-dry named as next step, no air-dry option ⇒ before_heat | PQ-11 r4 present but VP/VA r3 is FX-1 ⇒ hold_route present; buildup limb 1 via PQ-11 | „Sprungkraft" is movement, not flexibility
disagreements.B_rule_path: §4.3(3.4(ii));PH2-1 || notes: Lead Schwung/Elastizität has no defined job mapping (§6.10).
disagreements.comment: Lead C2 „Sorgt für mehr Schwung & [CLAIM] (Elastizität) im Haar". „Schwung" and „Elastizität" have no §6.10 job mapping. A volume; B review. Lean A (bounce/body is the volume job of a blow-dry lotion).

disagreements.name: alverde NATURKOSMETIK Locken Refresh-Spray
disagreements.A_rule_path: 4.1 pass | 4.2 lead house-brand C2 „Spray zur Auffrischung von Locken & Wellen" ⇒ curl revival, li_function yes | aqueous | 3.4(i) no fixative | 3.4(iii) LI G0 in_category ⇒ D6 | D6 (PH1-13 R2): (1) no FX ✓; (2) oils (Helianthus r12, PCA Glyceryl Oleate r14, Isoamyl Laurate r16) and Brassica Alcohol r21 sit below T_LI Levulinic Acid r6 ⇒ not care; Brassicyl Isoleucinate Esylate r17 (CA-1) sits below the yardstick Lactic Acid r13 ⇒ not care ✓; (3) styling-look promise ✓ ⇒ styling refresher | 4.5 PH1-16 ⇒ held (agrees with §4.6 registry, §11.6) || notes: candidate_below_tail: oils + the Esylate/Brassica Alcohol pair below T_S would make weight rich | sprayed strand by strand on dry (first-named) or damp hair, no shaping ⇒ dry_finish, also damp | „Mit Bio-Traubenkern- & Leinsamen-[CLAIM]" is a call-out
disagreements.B_rule_path: §4.3(D6);§4.5;PH2-2 || notes: provisional; lean_route=styling; not matchable before addendum approval. | Oil r12, esters r14/r16, Brassica Alcohol r21 and flax extract r25 below T_S. | Brassicyl Isoleucinate Esylate r17 below Lactic Acid r13: no effective care under R2.
disagreements.comment: Dry-hair application with no explicit shaping step (strand-by-strand spraying to revive curls; a cream rubbed between the palms and distributed through dry hair). §6.11 anchors: dry_finish „applied over the finished style, with no further shaping" vs dry_restyle „applied to dry hair, then shaped by hand or comb". A dry_finish, B dry_restyle. §11.6 (alverde) is the worked example both lanes cite.

disagreements.B_rule_path: §4.3(D6);§4.5;PH2-2 || notes: provisional; lean_route=styling; not matchable before addendum approval. | Dropped shine: formula gate fails. Magnesium Sulfate r7 and Shea Butter r10 below T_S.
disagreements.comment: Dry-hair application with no explicit shaping step (strand-by-strand spraying to revive curls; a cream rubbed between the palms and distributed through dry hair). §6.11 anchors: dry_finish „applied over the finished style, with no further shaping" vs dry_restyle „applied to dry hair, then shaped by hand or comb". rule_gap_register.issue: What counts as the care half (a care noun/verb stated as a job; a care word in the name such as „Detangling" or „Care"; an adjective on the result such as „gepflegte Locken"; an ingredient call-out) and what counts as the definition half (curl definition only, or also curl revival/reactivation and an unqualified „Definition").
rule_gap_register.impact: 2 route splits now; at scale every curl spray/refresher with a care word
rule_gap_register.proposed_fix: Add to §4.2 after the R1-Q3 paragraph: „The care half is a care job the C1/C2 promise states — moisturise, nourish, repair, condition, detangle (incl. those words in the confirmed name: Pflege-, Care, Detangling, Feuchtigkeits-). It is not an adjective describing the styled result („gepflegte Locken", „geschmeidige Locken"), a feel line („Verbesserte Geschmeidigkeit" stays care only where §11.2 says so) or an ingredient call-out (SFS-15 governs over R1-H2 for those). The definition half is a promise to define, shape or form curls/waves („definiert", „Definition" on a product for curly hair); reviving or reactivating curls (refresher job) is not definition." Replace R1-H2's „or an adjective" with „or a care word in the name".

rule_gap_register.impact: primary job of hold-led molding/hairspray products
rule_gap_register.proposed_fix: Amend RG-11: „A strength phrase is not job-bearing when it qualifies a product noun or follows another job phrase („Gel mit mittlerem Halt"); when the hold is the lead's subject („Intensiver Halt für …", „Starker Halt –"), the lead states hold_fix."

rule_gap_register.section: standard §4.2 li_function („curl support"), §4.2 step 1 (name job-word count), §6.10 RG-11 („shaping ⇒ hold_fix")
source: round-2 diff (Overnight Wellenspray reason, Syoss Curl Cream Gel and Nutricurls Curl Shaper primary jobs)
lane A handback „curl noun as job word in names"
rule_gap_register.issue: Curl nouns combined with setting/shaping verbs: is „Locken formen", „Curl Shaper", „Styling-Spray für Locken über Nacht" curl support/definition or shaping/hold; does „Curl Shaper (Defining Gel Cream)" name one job or two.
rule_gap_register.proposed_fix: Add to §6.10 and §4.2: „A curl/wave noun with a shaping or setting verb („Locken formen", „Curl Shaper", „Wellen über Nacht") states curl definition (li_function yes, primary definition); shaping without a curl noun maps to hold_fix (RG-11). Name job words naming the same job (Curl + Defining + Shaper on a curl product) count as one job."

source: lane B ambiguous_rules §6.10 („Schwung and Elastizität have no explicit primary-job mapping")
rule_gap_register.issue: „Schwung", „Sprungkraft", „Elastizität", „Fülle" have no job mapping.
rule_gap_register.proposed_fix: Add to §6.10: „Schwung, Sprungkraft, Spannkraft, Fülle ⇒ volume; Elastizität is a flexibility word (§6.9), never a job."

rule_gap_register.issue: „Glättet abstehende Haare" — smoothing (sleek) or flyaway control (frizz_control).
rule_gap_register.proposed_fix: Add to §6.10: „Taming or smoothing flyaways, abstehende Haare/Härchen or Babyhaare ⇒ frizz_control; sleek only for a smooth/straight result of the whole style („glatte Looks", „Sleek-Look")."

source: round-2 diff (alverde Locken Refresh, Cantu Comeback Curl, JF Zauberformel)
rule_gap_register.issue: Dry-hair application by strand-wise spraying or hand distribution with no explicit shaping step.
rule_gap_register.impact: routine slot of refreshers and finishing creams
rule_gap_register.proposed_fix: Add to §6.11: „dry_restyle needs a shaping act named in the directions (kneten, einkneten, formen, stylen, in Form bringen, toupieren); spraying or distributing on dry hair without one is dry_finish. A product applied to revive curls by spraying strands is dry_finish; „und nach Wunsch stylen" makes it dry_restyle."

source: round-2 diff (Redken Powder Grip, Redken Root Tease)
rule_gap_register.issue: Directions that apply and then shape (kneten, toupieren, Haarlinie formen) but name no moisture state: dry_restyle or unresolved.
rule_gap_register.impact: application_moment of powders, teasing sprays, edge gels
rule_gap_register.proposed_fix: Add to §6.11 (mirror of RG-2): „Directions that name a shaping step but no moisture state, no drying and no heat step read dry_restyle, confidence moderate; missing or copied directions stay unresolved."

rule_gap_register.issue: Ranges („vom Ansatz bis in die Spitzen", „beginnend an den Spitzen … zum Ansatz") and emphasis („besonders auf abstehende Härchen") are read as roots/lengths/surface by one lane and all by the other.
rule_gap_register.proposed_fix: Add to §6.12: „A range that spans the hair length in either direction („vom Ansatz bis in die Spitzen", „von den Spitzen zum Ansatz") is all. An emphasis inside a whole-hair instruction („im Haar verteilen, besonders auf …") is all; surface/lengths/roots need the zone to be the only application site."

source: lane B ambiguous_rules §6.8 („natürlich aussehendes Finish"; „Halbmatt read in the matt family")
rule_gap_register.issue: „natürlich aussehendes Finish" has a participle between natürlich and Finish; „halbmatt" is not listed.
rule_gap_register.proposed_fix: Add to §6.8: „natürlich aussehendes Finish / natürlich wirkender Look ⇒ natürlich (same phrase as natürliches Finish); halbmatt, seidenmatt ⇒ matt."

rule_gap_register.issue: „Stylen, Ausbürsten, wieder Stylen" (restylable?), „verformbar" (Taft Paste), „Elastizität" are in no list.
rule_gap_register.proposed_fix: Add to §6.9 beweglich: „verformbar, wieder stylen / neu stylen (a restyling sequence such as „Stylen, Ausbürsten, wieder Stylen"), Elastizität"; keep „ausbürstbar" alone as not flexibility (PH2-11).

source: lane A handback „no subtype anchor for a heatless overnight setting spray"
rule_gap_register.issue: No subtype anchor for a heatless overnight wave/curl setting spray (sprayed damp or dry, set with curlers/braids).
rule_gap_register.impact: subtype of a growing heatless-styling segment
rule_gap_register.proposed_fix: Add to the §5 gel row: „incl. setting sprays/lotions for heatless sets (curlers, braids, overnight): hold + definition, damp or dry, shaped by a tool" ⇒ gel; mousse stays foam-only (form tie-break).

source: round-2 diff (Syoss Curl Cream Gel subtype)
rule_gap_register.issue: Which „form" decides: the packet's format field („cream") or the formula/self-description („Gel", cast to scrunch out). The Power Flex precedent reads the formula.
rule_gap_register.proposed_fix: Add to §5: „Form = what the product is as applied — a gel/jelly (carbomer- or polymer-thickened, self-described Gel, cast expected) is gel even when sold as a cream (Power Flex, Syoss Curl Cream Gel); the capture format field is not a tie-breaker on its own."

source: lane A handback „smoothing_styler vs shine_finish tie-break"
lane A subtype readings (gotGloss, taft x Gliss Shine Coat)
rule_gap_register.issue: A shine/anti-frizz spray whose directions apply it before the blow-dryer or iron reads smoothing_styler by the moment tie-break, although its job is shine.
rule_gap_register.proposed_fix: Clarify §5: „smoothing_styler needs a sleek/straight result as the job; a shine lead stays shine_finish whatever the moment (moment breaks the tie only between two subtypes the job leaves open)."

rule_gap_register.issue: RG-12 maps hold/frizz/shine/definition words; it does not say whether volume, texture and sleek words in non-lead claims may be secondaries. B adds them (texture, volume) on 15+ records; A does not.
rule_gap_register.proposed_fix: State RG-12 as closed or open: recommended open — „any job word of the §6.10 vocabulary stated in a C1/C2 promise line (not in feel, ingredient or duration lines), in claim order, max two, after the primary"; or keep closed and say „only these four mappings create secondaries".

rule_gap_register.section: standard §5 step 3 / §6.10 RG-11 (job-less lead on a wax stick)
rule_gap_register.issue: A lead with no job word („Haarwachs-Stift für trendige Styles") vs specific shine/flyaway lines and dry-finish directions: product-noun fallback (molding) or the specific lines (shine_finish). Both lanes chose shine_finish.
rule_gap_register.proposed_fix: Add to §4.2: „A lead line with no job word is skipped; the next C1/C2 line with a job word is the lead."

rule_gap_register.issue: „mittlerer Kontrolle" (Redken Wax Spray) and „krass/ultra krass" (got2b) are not in §7.4, while §7.8 binds „ultra krass" ⇒ 4. Both lanes gave 2 and 4.

owner_questions.question: Which words make a curl product „care + curl definition" (and so a hand-reviewed mixed product)? (a) Only a care job the product promises (spendet Feuchtigkeit, pflegt, repariert, entwirrt — incl. „Pflege"/„Care"/„Detangling" in the name), or (b) any care word, including an adjective on the result such as „gepflegte Locken"? And does reviving or reactivating curls count as „curl definition"?
examples: Redken Refreshing Curl Mist: „revitalisiert und reaktiviert Locken … für gestylte und gepflegte Locken". Reading (a): not mixed ⇒ held Styling refresher (lane A). Reading (b): mixed ⇒ manual review (lane B).

Wella EIMI Nutricurls Fresh Up („Curl Refreshing Detangling Spray", „Locken reaktivieren"): if „Detangling" is care and reactivation is definition ⇒ mixed (lane A); if reactivation is only refresh ⇒ Leave-in by D6 (lane B).
owner_questions.affects: 2 route splits now; sealed slot 7 (Moroccanoil Glättende Creme, both lanes mixed); every curl spray/refresher with a care word
owner_questions.recommendation: Choose (a), and say curl revival is not curl definition (the definition half needs „definiert/Definition"). It keeps „mixed" for products that really sell both jobs, follows SFS-15, and sends Redken Curl Mist to the held refresher queue and Nutricurls Fresh Up to Leave-in (after its tier re-stamp, P2-6).

owner_questions.question: A water-based anti-frizz „Haarserum" whose conditioner sits one rank below the preservative: Oil (the „Serum" name rule, as v0.2's new serum test now says) or Leave-in (as the registry names it)?
examples: Balea Haarserum Anti-Frizz Glatt & Glossy: Aqua r1, Cetearyl Alcohol r3, Behentrimonium Chloride r12 just below Ethylhexylglycerin r11 ⇒ v0.2 letter Oil (lane A); registry Leave-in (lane B).
Contrast Balea Pro Haarserum Glow & Shine (Behentrimonium Chloride r5, above the preservative) ⇒ Leave-in under both.
owner_questions.affects: one route now; every water-based serum near the line
owner_questions.recommendation: Leave-in: widen the serum test to read the conditioner the way D6 already does (down to the first pH adjuster after the preservative). The registry outcome then follows from the letter, no override needed.

owner_questions.question: The blind S0 packet removes finish words (Glanz, Shine, Gloss, Finish) and blanks them in product names. For shine products those words are the product's job. Should the blind packet keep job-naming nouns and only remove grading words?
examples: OSiS Sparkler: „ein Glanz-Spray für … glänzendes Haar … leichtes Finish" becomes „ein [CLAIM]-Spray für … [CLAIM] Haar … leichtes [CLAIM]": lane B stopped at the evidence gate, lane A guessed a shine spray.
taft x Gliss „Glanz-Spray … Silky Shine" becomes „[CLAIM]-Spray … Silky [CLAIM]": lane B read the next line „Styling & Pflege in einem" ⇒ mixed, lane A reconstructed „Shine" ⇒ Styling.
owner_questions.affects: 3 route splits and 2 primary-job splits in this round; blinding integrity (a lane reconstructing blanked words is no longer blind)
owner_questions.recommendation: Yes. Keep job nouns (Glanz-Spray, Shine, Gloss, Finish/Finishing, Haarspray, Wachs, Puder) in S0 lines and the confirmed name; keep removing hold strength, flexibility and finish grading adjectives, numbers and scales; put the unredacted name into the claims packet. Re-run only the affected records.

owner_questions.question: NEQI Diamond Glass All is the fixative-free sibling of NEQI Diamond Glass Ultimate (ruled Leave-in). By the letter it is „Styling + Hitzeschutz in einem" ⇒ mixed ⇒ manual review. Extend the Ultimate ruling to it?
examples: NEQI Diamond Glass All: same Polysilicone-29 + Silicone Quaternium-18 film, no fixative; lane A mixed (review), lane B Leave-in.
owner_questions.recommendation: Yes, extend the row (Leave-in is also what the letter's Leave-in reading gives), after the INCI-truncation flag is cleared (P2-3).
